name: japanophile-mcp
description: Japanophile workstation: kanji/JLPT/vocab learning tools plus Japanese culture knowledge box. First -phile repo.

tools.name: kanji
tools.description: Kanji dictionary: lookup, search, by_jlpt, by_grade, by_radical, random over 13,108 entries.

tools.name: jlpt
tools.description: JLPT quiz: next question, answer grading with progress store, session summaries.

tools.name: vocab
tools.description: Vocabulary search over 400k entries plus jmdict; JLPT-graded lists. Needs fetched kanji.db.

tools.name: knowledge
tools.description: Culture knowledge box: list and read 30 Japan pages (history, culture, econ, travel, 2026 snapshot).

tools.name: japanophile_help
tools.description: Tool list, per-DB status, ports. Agents call this first.
